tenderSchedule.description: Supply, Installation & Commissioning of Air Conditioning units at Munirabad Dam Power House
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer OANDM Office KVP MBDPH

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Office of the Executive Engineer ( O and M) MBDPH, Munirabad Dam Power House, Munirabad

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Conditional bids, incomplete bids, bids without EMD, bids not uploaded properly and late submission of bids shall be rejected

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Work experience: The prospective bidder shall have satisfactorily completed, as a prime contractor at least one similar work of Supply, Installation and Commissioning of Air Conditioner unit in any power plant /PSU/Government organization/ Private power utility /Reputed industry in the preceding five years (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023- 24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). In proof of this, the bidder should submit copy of single workorder of value not less than Rs.1.41 lakhs and corresponding satisfactory performance/work done certificate issued by competent authority (in case of state/central Government/Government under taking from officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent cadre and in case of KPCL not below the rank of Chief Engineer). (A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous work orders to bring to the current financial year).

Qualification: The bidder in his name, shall have in the last five years (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) achieved at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 2.82 lakhs in proof of this Turnover Certificate duly certified by Charted Accountant shall be furnished. (A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous annual turnover value to bring the current price level to current financial year).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: Declaration that bidders Coverage of contractors labourers under PF Act(format in page-6).

The intending bidder shall also enclose the attested copies of the followings : (1) Income tax PAN. (2) GST registration certificate. (3) Independent PF code
Declaration that bidders offer has no conditions contravening the commercial conditions of the bid(format in page-7).

Declaration by the bidder that he has studied the site conditions (technical parameters and requirements pertaining to scope of work of tender booklet), labour conditions and read the bid documents and related matters carefully and diligently and that he has submitted the bid having studied, understood and accepted the full implications of the agreement(format in page-7).
Declaration by the bidder that, the payment to the contract labours will be made as per Minimum wage act 1948(format in page-8).

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Supply, Installation & Commissioning of Air Conditioning units at Munirabad Dam Power House

itemList.description: Supply of Commercial 3 Ton capacity inverter model air conditioner (Make: Voltas, Blue star Godrej/ Equivalent)

Supplying of 1.5 TR 3 star Invertor type split Air conditioners suitable for operation on A/C supply single phase 50 Hz 230 V with hermetically sealed inverter compressor with air cooled condenser, latest R410A / R-32 refrigerant fan motor, start & run capacitors, relay & over load protector internal unit, with one indoor & one outdoor unit The condenser unit will be placed outside the room avoid noise including standard length of suitable size copper tubing covered with nitrile rubber insulation tube. suitable capacity 3 core sheathed/ PVC copper cable and a battery operated wireless remote unit.
Installation charges for split type wall mount air conditioner with allied works for one indoor and one outdoor unit is to be mounted on suitable Angle Iron support up to 3.0 Ton split A/C
